description: Specializes in online financial fraud, cyber-stalking, unauthorized computer access, digital extortion, and electronic evidence preservation under BSA 2023 / IT Act.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended when facing complex online financial scams, account takeover, non-consensual image distribution, or when dealing with cybercrime police units and digital evidence certificates.
bar_council_guidance: Consult advocates enrolled with your State Bar Council possessing specialized experience in cyber forensics and information technology law.

description: Focuses on deficiency of service, non-delivery of products by e-commerce companies, medical negligence, insurance claim repudiations, and complaints before District/State Consumer Commissions.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended when an e-commerce platform, manufacturer, builder, or service provider fails to deliver, denies a lawful refund, or engages in unfair trade practices.
bar_council_guidance: Consumers can also represent themselves in Consumer Commissions, or engage a verified advocate registered with the local District Consumer Bar Association.

description: Handles FIR registration, anticipatory bail, regular bail, police interrogation rights, trial defence, and criminal complaints under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and BNSS.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended whenever there is a risk of arrest, severe physical threats, extortion, cognizable cheating, or when navigating police station proceedings.
bar_council_guidance: Always engage an advocate enrolled with your State Bar Council. If unable to afford counsel, you have a statutory right to free legal aid from DLSA under Article 39A.

description: Advises on wrongful termination, unpaid salary claims, non-compete covenants, severance packages, workplace sexual harassment (POSH), and labour court proceedings.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended when your employer withholds salary, illegally terminates your contract without notice pay, or fails to settle full-and-final dues.
bar_council_guidance: Verify that the advocate regularly practices before Labour Courts, Industrial Tribunals, or the High Court in employment matters.

description: Specializes in rental security deposit disputes, lease agreements, eviction proceedings, title verification, and civil suits under Transfer of Property Act and State Rent Acts.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended when landlords unlawfully retain security deposits, threaten illegal eviction, or when title/tenancy disputes arise.
bar_council_guidance: Consult civil advocates practicing before local Civil Courts or Rent Controllers in the municipal jurisdiction where the property is situated.

description: Expert in filing Writ Petitions (Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Certiorari) before High Courts (Art 226) and Supreme Court (Art 32) against arbitrary government actions.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended when public authorities, government departments, or universities violate your fundamental rights or act without legal authority.
bar_council_guidance: Engage an advocate practicing directly before the relevant State High Court or Supreme Court of India.

description: Handles maintenance under BNSS Sec 144, domestic violence protection orders, mutual and contested divorce, child custody, and family court mediation.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended during marital disputes, domestic abuse, denial of maintenance to dependent spouse or children, or child custody disputes.
bar_council_guidance: Look for practitioners enrolled with the local Family Court Bar Association who emphasize conciliation and mediation.

description: Handles cheque bounce cases under Section 138 NI Act, loan recovery harassment by recovery agents, RBI Banking Ombudsman complaints, and DRT proceedings.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended when a cheque is dishonoured, when facing aggressive loan recovery tactics, or in unauthorized banking transactions.
bar_council_guidance: Engage an advocate with expertise in negotiable instruments, criminal courts, and consumer forums.

description: Specializes in claiming compensation for road accident injuries, fatalities, hit-and-run incidents, and third-party insurance claims before Claims Tribunals.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended following serious motor vehicle accidents to secure statutory compensation from insurance companies within the 6-month limitation period.
bar_council_guidance: Verify the advocate's experience before the local Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal.

description: Advises on contract breaches, recovery of money, injunctions against third parties, responding to legal notices, and declaratory civil suits.
when_needed_criteria: Recommended upon receiving a formal legal notice from another party or when preparing to initiate civil litigation for damages.
bar_council_guidance: Ensure timely replies to legal notices through an enrolled advocate to protect your legal defence.
